L=/var/lib/bench70231694
KC="sudo $L/bin/kubectl"
BK=unix:///run/bench70231694/buildkit/buildkitd.sock
waitbk() { for _ in $(seq 1 30); do sudo $L/libexec/buildctl --addr $BK debug workers >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; }
# the worker gets the namespace default by a new configuration file; the Pod is made again with the socket directory at /bk and BUILDKIT_HOST;
# buildctl is copied into the new Pod
sudo tee $L/buildkit/buildkitd.toml >/dev/null <<EOF
root = "$L/buildkit/root"
[grpc]
  address = ["unix:///run/bench70231694/buildkit/buildkitd.sock"]
[worker.oci]
  enabled = false
[worker.containerd]
  enabled = true
  address = "/run/bench70231694/containerd.sock"
  namespace = "default"
EOF
sudo $L/bin/buildkitctl restart
waitbk
$KC delete pod builder --wait >/dev/null
sudo tee $L/builder.yaml >/dev/null <<'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: builder
spec:
  containers:
    - name: nerdctl
      image: bench70231694.local/builder:1
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      env:
        - name: BUILDKIT_HOST
          value: unix:///bk/buildkitd.sock
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 0
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /workspace
          name: workspace
          readOnly: true
        - mountPath: /run/containerd/containerd.sock
          name: containerd
        - mountPath: /bk
          name: bk
  restartPolicy: Always
  volumes:
    - name: workspace
      hostPath:
        path: /var/lib/bench70231694/workspace
    - name: containerd
      hostPath:
        path: /run/bench70231694/containerd.sock
    - name: bk
      hostPath:
        path: /run/bench70231694/buildkit
EOF
$KC apply -f $L/builder.yaml >/dev/null
$KC wait --for=condition=Ready pod/builder --timeout=120s >/dev/null
$KC cp $L/libexec/buildctl builder:/usr/local/bin/buildctl
$KC exec builder -- chmod +x /usr/local/bin/buildctl
$KC exec builder -- nerdctl build -t bench70231694.local/payload:1 /workspace

L=/var/lib/bench70231694

sudo sed -i 's/^\([[:space:]]*namespace = \).*/\1"default"/' $L/buildkit/buildkitd.toml
sudo $L/bin/buildkitctl restart
waitbk
$KC cp $L/libexec/buildctl builder:/usr/local/bin/buildctl
$KC exec builder -- chmod +x /usr/local/bin/buildctl
$KC exec builder -- nerdctl build -t bench70231694.local/payload:1 /workspace

# the reference solution without the change of the worker's namespace: the base image is not found by a worker in the namespace buildkit
sed -e '/buildkitd.toml/d' -e '/buildkitctl restart/d' cases/compatibility/q70231694/reference_solution.sh | bash

# the worker keeps the namespace buildkit; the base image is copied there and the Pod's nerdctl is told to use that namespace: the build works,
# but the image is not in the namespace default of the node
sudo ctr -a /run/bench70231694/containerd.sock -n default images export /tmp/bench70231694-base.tar localhost/bench70231694-base:1
sudo ctr -a /run/bench70231694/containerd.sock -n buildkit images import /tmp/bench70231694-base.tar
sudo rm -f /tmp/bench70231694-base.tar
